definition: Human as a quality is a Quality parameter; HumanFormAdmitted marks its inclusion in the range of Forms as an explicit optional open commitment. It asserts neither a human Form’s existence by itself nor that the Form is an ordinary human.
note: Semantic interface for the bounded issue #257 readings. Primary passages motivate this sense but do not define this modern relational encoding. A sourced replacement would need a passage fixing precisely these semantic boundaries.
